content.title: When does ‘Daredevil: Born Again’ Season 2 premiere? Release date, time, how to stream
content.text: Updated: Mar. 23, 2026, 5:30 p.m.Published: Mar. 23, 2026, 5:30 p.m."Daredevil: Born Again" Season 2 premieres Tuesday, March 24, on Disney+.Disney+If you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Madison Kemeny | MKemeny@syracuse.comMarvel’s “Daredevil: Born Again” returns with a second season that plunges Hell’s Kitchen into chaos. With Wilson Fisk now sworn in as New York City’s mayor and vigilantism outlawed, Matt Murdock must operate from the shadows to expose Kingpin’s rise to power and reclaim the city he’s sworn to protect.When does ‘Daredevil: Born Again’ Season 2 premiere?“Daredevil: Born Again” Season 2 premieres Tuesday, March 24, exclusively on Disney+, with the first episode dropping at 9 p.m. ET. New episodes will drop weekly each Tuesday.How to watch ‘Daredevil: Born Again’ Season 2The new season of “Daredevil: Born Again” is streaming only on Disney+.Although Disney+ doesn’t offer a free trial, viewers can bundle their subscriptions to reduce the monthly cost. The Disney+ and Hulu bundle combines Disney+ with Hulu for $12.99/month, saving 45% compared to subscribing separately. The Disney Unlimited bundle combines Disney+, Hulu and ESPN+ together, offering additional live sports and entertainment programming for $35.99/month, saving 33%.Disney+Starting at $11.99/moStream Seasons 1 and 2 of 'Daredevil: Born Again' on Disney+.Stream NowAbout ‘Daredevil: Born Again’ Season 2According to the series’ official logline, “Mayor Wilson Fisk crushes New York City underfoot as he hunts down public enemy number one, the Hell’s Kitchen vigilante known as Daredevil. But beneath the horned mask, Matt Murdock will try to fight back from the shadows to tear down the Kingpin’s corrupt empire and redeem his home. Resist. Rebel. Rebuild.”Watch the trailer below:Who stars in ‘Daredevil: Born Again’ Season 2“Daredevil: Born Again” Season 2 is led once again by Charlie Cox as Matt Murdock/Daredevil and Vincent D’Onofrio as Wilson Fisk/Kingpin. The new season also brings back Deborah Ann Woll as Karen Page, who reunites with Matt as she works to uncover Fisk’s expanding criminal network.Wilson Bethel reprises his role as Benjamin Poindexter/Bullseye, and Krysten Ritter returns as Jessica Jones.
